products_list.description:
Italian 925 Sterling Silver Rope Chain – 6mm | 22"

Crafted in Italy from genuine .925 sterling silver, this classic rope chain features tightly woven links that twist into a continuous spiral. As it moves, the braided profile catches the light from every angle.

At 6mm thick, it offers a substantial, noticeable presence without feeling overly bulky—strong enough to wear solo as a centerpiece or paired with a heavy pendant. The 22-inch length rests comfortably just below the collarbone, making it a versatile fit for everyday wear or dressing up.

Why You'll Love It
Genuine .925 sterling silver, stamped for authenticity
Made in Italy by master silversmiths with tight, durable link construction
Diamond-cut / high-polish finish that reflects light from every angle of the twist
6mm thickness, striking the balance between bold statement and daily comfort
22-inch length, sitting comfortably below the collarbone
Heavy-duty lobster clasp for a reliable, secure hold
Hypoallergenic & nickel-free, safe for sensitive skin

products_list.description:
Italian 925 Sterling Silver Figaro Chain – 9mm | 22"
This Figaro chain is made in Italy from solid .925 sterling silver. The pattern is the classic Figaro: groups of short, flat links broken up by one longer link, repeated along the chain.

At 9mm wide, it's a heavy chain that stands out whether you wear it by itself or with a pendant. The 22-inch length sits just below the collarbone and works for both men and women.

Why You'll Love It
Genuine .925 sterling silver, stamped to show it's authentic
Made in Italy by skilled silversmiths, with tight, even links
Polished to a high shine that catches the light
9mm wide, with real weight and a solid feel
22-inch length that suits most necklines
Secure lobster clasp, easy to put on and take off
Hypoallergenic and safe for everyday wear
Good for layering or for wearing with a pendant
